name: Alcaz Prison

entrance.note: Forever-only dungeon on Alcaz Island, Dustwallow Marsh. Catalog entrance is null (not published). Official location is Alcaz Island. Sergeant Ulka stands on the island at 70.3, 18.85. Travel is boat or swim — there is no flight path on the island.

travel.how: Start the breadcrumb with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar (The Missing Kor'kron 95283) and fly to Brackenwall Village to Nazeer Bloodpike. Alcaz Island is off the northeast Dustwallow coast; there is no flight path. Boat or swim from the Dustwallow shore to the island (Sergeant Ulka 70.3, 18.85). Do not start the dungeon quests without 95283 → 95284 → 95285.

quests.name: The Missing Kor'kron
quests.notes: Required breadcrumb. Speak with Nazeer in Brackenwall. Catalog/README: Horde access is this Eitrigg → Brackenwall breadcrumb. Planner must take 95283 before any Alcaz Island quest. XP 1300 from QuestieDB. verified:false. foreverConfidence:high. steps-v2 routes: balanced only.

quests.name: The Elite of the Elite
quests.notes: Find the missing Kor'kron Elites; turn in on Alcaz Island (boat/swim from Brackenwall). Catalog prerequisitesByName: The Missing Kor'kron. QuestieDB has no pre on 95284. XP 1300 from QuestieDB. leadsTo 95285. verified:false.

quests.name: Right Place, Wrong Time
quests.notes: Talk to Ulka on the island. QuestieDB pre.single 95284. Unlocks the dungeon quests (95309, 96332, 96334). XP 1300 from QuestieDB. Not in the original fan-guide list of 40. verified:false.

quests.name: No Orc Left Behind
quests.notes: Enter Alcaz Prison and find Commander Folkar. No turn-in in the import. QuestieDB pre.single 95285; README/prerequisitesByName say The Elite of the Elite (95284). No steps-v2 ids. Run tip: Do not accept No Orc Left Behind. XP unknown. Skip unless you are chasing the inner Kor'kron/Varian chain (95454→96369→95483).

quests.name: The Honor of the Kor'kron
quests.notes: Look for King Varian Wrynn in Alcaz Prison. Import has no start or end NPC/object/item — not invented. Needs 95309. No steps-v2 ids. XP unknown. Skip with the 95309 chain.

quests.name: Bad News for Folkar
quests.notes: Report back to Commander Folkar. Import has no start or end. Needs 95454. No steps-v2 ids. XP unknown. Skip with the 95309 chain.

quests.name: Thrall Needs to Know
quests.notes: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall. Import has no start NPC. Needs 96369. No steps-v2 ids. XP unknown. Skip with the 95309 chain.

quests.name: A Little Payback
quests.notes: Kill 15 Strashasz Soldiers, 8 Strashaz Enchantresses, and Tidemistress Ca'zass; turn in to Ulka on the island. QuestieDB pre.single 95285; README/prerequisitesByName say The Elite of the Elite (95284). No XP in QuestieDB. verified:false. Do not pick up without 95283→95284→95285.

quests.name: Blood Red Bandanas
quests.notes: Collect 8 Blood Red Bandanas from human guards inside. Catalog/Questie turn-in is Eitrigg in Orgrimmar; README only names Ulka as giver. QuestieDB pre.single 95285; README/prerequisitesByName say 95284. No XP in QuestieDB. Do not pick up without the Eitrigg breadcrumb.

quests.name: The Man in the Iron Chains
quests.notes: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner. Catalog minLevel null. Import has no start, end, or pre — not invented. No steps-v2 ids. XP unknown. foreverEvidence includes authoredFix. Skip.

prep.group: Five-player Forever dungeon on Alcaz Island. Run once around 51. Do not accept No Orc Left Behind (steps-v2 run tip). At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour.
consumables: water walking or a fast swim if you have it
warnings: Full breadcrumb before any dungeon quest: 95283 The Missing Kor'kron (Eitrigg, Orgrimmar) → 95284 The Elite of the Elite (Nazeer, Brackenwall) → 95285 Right Place, Wrong Time (Ulka, Alcaz Island). Do not start 96332/96334 without it.
Travel is Dustwallow boat or swim to Alcaz Island. No island flight path. Entrance coordinates are not published.
steps-v2 Alcaz steps are routes: balanced only.
All ten catalog quests stay verified:false until checked in game. Do not invent missing givers, turn-ins, or XP.
Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP (Blizzard Forever hotfixes through 20 Nov 2026).

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Same 48-53 band as Alcaz. Jintha'Alor and the Wildhammer message chain are the slow Revantusk work a Dustwallow island run would replace.
Same band. Scrimshank, Dunemaul, Thirsty Goblin, and balanced-only Thistleshrub Valley are the slow Gadgetzan completes if Alcaz is covering 48-51.
Upper Alcaz band. Kim'jael, satyr, and the short Azshara breadcrumb XP (530) are the other slow 51-53 work.

notes: Forever-only dungeon (id alcaz-prison), official levels 48-53, Alcaz Island, Dustwallow Marsh. runAt 51 (48+3). 10 of 10 Horde catalog quests matched to QuestieDB v1.1.3; all verified:false. Pack emits breadcrumb 95283→95284→95285 then 96332 and 96334. Travel is fly Brackenwall then boat/swim to the island.
